title: H. G. Wells: The War of the Worlds — Ep 02/27 — "The Falling Star"
description:
The War of the Worlds, Episode 2. A falling star streaks over Winchester in the small hours, and nobody troubles to look for it -- nobody but Ogilvy the astronomer, who walks out onto Horsell Common at dawn and finds a pit, and in the pit a thing no meteorite ever was: a vast crusted cylinder, still hot, and something inside it slowly unscrewing the lid.

He runs for Woking to raise help. A waggoner drives on; a potman takes him for a lunatic; and only Henderson, the London journalist, digging in his garden, will listen. By nine o'clock the whole town is on its way to see the dead men from Mars.

Chapter II of Book One of H. G. Wells's The War of the Worlds (1898), in the public domain.

— The Keeper's Lantern —
Every episode is one whole chapter, in order, from the first page to the last.
